name: MSA Clausier (English)
description: Key clause extraction from a Master Service Agreement under English/common law

columns.label: Scope of Services
columns.question: What is the main scope of services described in the agreement?

columns.label: Term & Renewal
columns.question: What is the initial term of the agreement? Is there automatic renewal? What are the notice requirements?

columns.label: Fees & Pricing
columns.question: What are the pricing arrangements (fixed fee, time & materials, unit pricing)? Are there rate adjustment provisions?

columns.label: Payment Terms
columns.question: What are the payment terms, invoicing schedule, and late payment consequences?

columns.label: Limitation of Liability
columns.question: What is the liability cap? Are indirect/consequential damages excluded? Are there any carve-outs?

columns.label: Warranties
columns.question: What warranties are given regarding the services (SLAs, fitness for purpose, compliance)?

columns.label: Intellectual Property
columns.question: Who owns deliverables and work product? What background IP rights are granted?

columns.label: Confidentiality
columns.question: What is the duration of the confidentiality obligation? Are there carve-outs for compelled disclosure?

columns.label: Termination
columns.question: What are the grounds and notice periods for termination? What are the consequences upon termination?

columns.label: Governing Law
columns.question: What is the governing law and jurisdiction or arbitration clause?
